title: Cloud sync
description: Manage profiles, proxies, groups, tags and templates from app.softglaze.com while this PC is off. End-to-end encrypted: SoftGlaze cannot read it.
signIn: Sign in to your SoftGlaze account in Settings > Account to use cloud sync.
noOsEncryption: This computer's key store is not available, so cloud sync cannot keep its keys safe here.
planRequired: Cloud sync comes with Pro and Enterprise. Your profiles stay on this PC.
serverError: Could not reach the SoftGlaze server: {{message}}

off.title: Cloud sync is off
off.body: Turning it on uploads an encrypted copy of your profiles, proxies (with passwords), groups, tags and templates. Browser data, cookies, launch flags and 2FA codes stay on this PC.
off.existsTitle: Your account already has a cloud workspace
off.existsBody: Connect this PC to it with the 24-word recovery kit you saved when you turned cloud sync on. Profiles on this PC are added to the workspace.
off.wordsPlaceholder: Type or paste the 24 words, in order

kit.title: Save your recovery kit
kit.body: These 24 words are the only way back into your cloud workspace if you lose every device. SoftGlaze does not have them and cannot reset them. Write them down or print them, and keep them offline.
kit.saved: I have saved my recovery kit somewhere safe
kit.printNote: Workspace {{id}}. Keep this page offline. Anyone with these words and your account can read your workspace.

on.title: Cloud sync is on
on.conflicts: Fields edited in two places (newest kept): {{count}}
on.auto: Syncs every 20 seconds while SoftGlaze is open.

enrol.title: Add a web browser
enrol.help: Open app.softglaze.com, sign in, choose Cloud sync and enter this code. It works once and for 10 minutes.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code for the one-time code

devices.title: Devices
devices.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? It stops receiving changes at once. It may keep a copy of what it already downloaded.

kitAgain.confirm: Make a new recovery kit? The old words stop working.
kitAgain.title: Your new recovery kit

turnOff.confirm: Turn cloud sync off on this PC? Your data stays on this PC.
turnOff.deleteCloud: Also delete the cloud copy (every device loses access; this PC keeps its data)
turnOff.deleteConfirm: Delete the encrypted cloud copy for every device? This cannot be undone.

errors.unavailable: Cloud sync is not available in this build.
